title: Nutrient profile of one Foundation Food (April 2025)
purpose: List every nutrient this FoodData Central release reports for one Foundation Food: the nutrient's id, number, name and unit, the amount per 100 g of the food, and the analytical data points with their minimum, maximum and median where published. Rows follow the release's nutrient rank. Each food and nutrient pair has one amount in this release.

parameters.name: fdc_id
parameters.description: FoodData Central id of a Foundation Food in this release

output_columns.name: amount
output_columns.description: Amount per 100 g of the food, as published

output_columns.name: data_points
output_columns.description: Number of analytical data points behind the amount
